Subject: Panel session — proposed times + agenda (Dec / Jan)

Hi all —

Thanks for agreeing to join a short panel-style demo / Q&A on Redwood inference. The goal is to walk through a 25-minute product demo focused on cost/latency tradeoffs for multi-tenant deployments, followed by a 20-minute live Q&A and a short break-out for architecture questions.

Two provisional session windows we can host:
- Option A: Tue, 2027-01-11 17:00 PST / Wed 01:00 CET (60 minutes)
- Option B: Wed, 2027-01-12 16:00 PST / Thu 00:00 CET (60 minutes)

Please reply with which option works for your team (or propose an alternate slot). I attached a one-page agenda.

Logistics: we’ll host on the Redwood webinar bridge (single link), and we’ll merge calendar invites once the time is locked. If you have a preferred calendar attendee (e.g., an ops or infra lead), feel free to CC them.

Attachments: redwood-panel-agenda.pdf (1 page)

Next step: can the Acme and Retail teams confirm by EOD Monday?

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
